name: com.oreethehat.easy-interaction
description: Composable interaction selection, actions, physical handling, cooperation and optional gameplay, UI, network and XR adapters for Unity 6.3.

samples.description: Minimal door and physical crate example. Requires EasyInteraction 0.3.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Core examples, reusable list/radial HUD, animation and prefabs. Requires EasyInteraction 0.3.0+, uGUI 2.0.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Pickup, atomic transfer and progressive costs. Requires EasyInteraction 0.3.0+, EasyResources 0.3.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Placed-building actions and selection through the shared actor session. Requires EasyBuilding 0.3.0+, EasyInteraction 0.3.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Health conditions, interruption and restore-aware actor state. Requires EasyCombat 0.7.0+, EasyInteraction 0.3.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Action feedback events and loops with an optional player context. Requires EasyFeedbacks 1.8.0+, EasyInteraction 0.3.0+. No prerequisite sample imports.
FPS approach and independently owned manual-input blocks. Requires EasyInteraction 0.3.0+, EasyMovement 5.1.0+, ECM2 (separate installation; tested with 1.4.3). No prerequisite sample imports.
NPC approach through NavMeshAgent. Requires EasyInteraction 0.3.0+, AI module 1.0.0, a baked NavMesh. No prerequisite sample imports.
Unity Localization string-table adapter; EasyLocalization is not required. Requires EasyInteraction 0.3.0+, Unity Localization 1.5.13+. No prerequisite sample imports.
Server-authoritative requests and world-state replication. Requires EasyInteraction 0.3.0+, Netcode for GameObjects 2.7.0+, a configured transport. No prerequisite sample imports.
XR interactor adapter with two-hand support. Requires EasyInteraction 0.3.0+, XR Interaction Toolkit 3.2.0+ (3.x), a configured XR rig. No prerequisite sample imports.
